sections.title: باب 4 — متن (6)

paras.text: Those living and working in the building should be aware of the laws and instructions.

paras.pashto: په ودانۍ کې اوسېدونکي او کارکوونکي دې له قوانینو او لارښوونو خبر وي.

paras.text: Emergency routes should be made and they should be made clear with signs.

paras.pashto: بیړنۍ لارې دې جوړې شي او په نښو دې روښانه شي.

paras.text: Such electrical appliances should be installed as do not become too hot, and in case of any fault do not give a flame nor start to smoulder.

paras.pashto: داسې برېښنايي وسایل دې ولګول شي چې ډېر ګرم نه شي او د کومې خرابۍ په صورت کې لمبه ورنه کړي او لوګي هم پیل نه کړي.

paras.text: Fire-extinguishing appliances should be easily available.
paras.urdu: آگ بجھانے والے آلات آسانی سے دستیاب ہوں۔
paras.pashto: د اور مړ کولو وسایل دې په اسانۍ برابر وي.

sections.theory:
Those living and working in the building should be aware of the laws and instructions.

Emergency routes should be made and they should be made clear with signs.

Such electrical appliances should be installed as do not become too hot, and in case of any fault do not give a flame nor start to smoulder.

Fire-extinguishing appliances should be easily available.

Fire-extinguishing appliances should be of good quality and in proper condition.

If different solutions, e.g. acid or chemicals, are used inside the building, then work with extreme attention and care while storing and using them.

Do not use smouldering and flame-giving things without need.

Get the building checked from time to time. If some fault comes, close the building until the defect is removed.

Get a fire-alarm system installed in the building.

Practical training should be given to the staff of the building and awareness should be further increased.

The staff of the building should be made to practise on an annual basis.

Sale and purchase of appliances

The sale and purchase of fire appliances and things should be with approved persons, i.e. they should have a government licence and permit, and these persons should be responsible for making, storing, transporting, selling and using these appliances and things.

آگ بجھانے کے آلات رکھنے والے سٹوروں، دکانداروں یا تجارت کرنے والوں کی نگرانی کرنی چاہیے تاکہ وہ ان …
